title: Cedar Glen Golf Club
specs: 18-hole golf course with three sets of tees and a variety of hole layouts framed by mature trees
Front nine features wide-open layout with water hazards; back nine is more demanding with tight tree-lined fairways and rolling greens
Golf outings can host up to 60 players during the week with restricted times and up to 200 people on the weekend

blurb: Cedar Glen Golf Club features an 18-hole golf course with three sets of tees, tight putting complexes, and a variety of hole layouts framed by mature trees. The front nine offers a wide-open layout with inviting fairways and water hazards, while the back nine is more demanding with tight tree-lined fairways and rolling greens.
